name: gilded ambusher
mana cost: {1}{B}{R}
types: enchantment creature lizard glimmer
power toughness: 4/2
triggered: whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice another nonland permanent. when you do, each opponent exiles a nonland, nontoken permanent they control and a random nonland card from their library, then CARDNAME deals damage to them equal to the total mana value of the cards exiled this way.
